facts.name: Dennis Craig
facts.assignment: Volusia Division31 circuit civil. Supplemental Putnam coverage limited to preserved September27,2022 order transferring then-pending circuit-wide Engle progeny cases to Division31; not a regular Putnam local assignment or claim about current case inventory.

procedure_checklist.communications: Use the assistant email for hearing coordination; proposed orders use Division31@circuit7.org.
procedure_checklist.scheduling: Coordinate routine civil hearings with opposing parties and book through Benchmark; hearings longer than30minutes go through the assistant. Only the assistant can cancel a hearing, on emailed request under the guide’s conditions.
procedure_checklist.appearances: Trials and evidentiary hearings ordinarily require in-person attendance. Email remote requests to the assistant with the other party copied and lack of objection stated; expedited hearings and case-management conferences do not require remote permission.
procedure_checklist.proposed_orders: Submit Word orders to Division31@circuit7.org after checking agreement, copy the opposing party and identify agreed orders. If parties disagree on form, each side submits its proposed order.
procedure_checklist.courtesy_copies: Deliver motions and case law for review to chambers by mail or hand delivery at least five days before the hearing.

facts.summary: Retained special cross-county assignment evidence and verified Volusia contacts/procedures; no litigation-specific research or general Putnam docket inference.
facts.review_scope: Prior original transfer/assignment statements and Volusia contact/practical procedure review reused. No Engle merits, dockets, individual cases or current transfer inventory examined.

reuse.note: Original acquisition timestamps preserved; artifacts recovered byte-for-byte from database.

gaps: No claim that any specific transferred case remains pending or that Division31 handles routine Putnam civil cases.

citations.quote:
IN THE CIRCUIT COURT OF FLORIDA, SEVENTH JUDICIAL CIRCUIT IN AND FOR FLAGLER, PUTNAM, ST. JOHNS AND VOLUSIA COUNTIES
Re: Transfer / Reassignment of Tobacco Litigation Engle Progeny Cases
Ref: G-2022-010-SC
WHEREAS
, it has been determined that in the interest of judicial economy, all tobacco litigation (
Engle
progeny cases) in the Seventh Judicial Circuit should reside in a single judicial division;
NOW THEREFORE, I, JAMES R. CLAYTON,
Chief Judge of the Seventh Judicial Circuit of Florida, hereby order that all tobacco litigation (
Engle
progeny cases) currently pending in the Seventh Judicial Circuit be transferred / reassigned to Division 31 (Volusia County, Civil).
TO BE RECORDED
in Flagler, Putnam, St. Johns and Volusia counties.
DONE AND ORDERED
in DeLand, Volusia County, Florida this 27
th
day of September 2022.
/s/ James R. Clayton
JAMES R. CLAYTON
Chief Judge
